text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I didn't expect to see you
so early in
the morning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't worry. My mind's as clear as
usual.
choice_data_list: Were you able to rest yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But, I tell ya, I can only take one day of
peace
and quiet. After that, I need some
action.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa smiles as usual. She
seems to
have gotten a good amount of
rest.
